claude.rationale: This was a whole-entity, all-cash reverse triangular merger in which "Orbital ATK's legal entity, product lines, and workforce transferred together into the acquirer's ownership structure" as a going concern, not a stripped asset sale; the customer-facing products (launch vehicles, missiles/ammunition, satellites) moved with the entity and its operational processes, so no product-vs-process mismatch exists (gap_45=0). The processes moved with the people/organization intact, reinforced by a 12-month employee-matters continuity covenant and a general transition/integration-cooperation covenant, so T5 and T6 aligned coherently at closing (gap_56=0). T1 is coded replace because at the effective time all Orbital ATK directors resigned and all officers ceased, with Sub's directors/officers installed and the entity renamed Northrop Grumman Innovation Systems.
